name: Alessandro Chiesa
one_sentence_summary: Alessandro Chiesa leads COMPSEC at EPFL, researching the theoretical foundations and practical constructions of cryptographic proofs including zkSNARKs, IOPs, proof-carrying data, and post-quantum secure argument systems, with new forays into provable AI inference.
matrix_summary: Alessandro Chiesa (COMPSEC) co-released **FlashProve** with Anthropic — an open-source zkSNARK system for provable AI inference that can prove a 400B-parameter LLM produced specific outputs at ~110 tokens/sec on one H100, with Lean formal proofs and Apache 2.0 code on GitHub. This is a high-profile real-world application of his cryptographic proof research with direct implications for AI safety, pacing, and regulation. Several new preprints and publications also dropped this cycle.
